domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
t is a real number and 0 <= t and t < 1
a equals floor(n times t), so a is an integer satisfying a <= n*t < a + 1
the expression a/n must be a valid input to E_n (so E_n must be defined at least for the value a/n that results from the floor construction)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n > 1 and every real t with 0 <= t < 1, letting a = floor(n*t), it holds that E_n(t) is less than or equal to E_n(a divided by n).
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
for all real numbers t with 0 <= t < 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: global parameter indexing the function E_n

variables.domain: all integers (but constrained by a = floor(n*t))
variables.name: a
variables.role: witness defined as the floor of n*t, used to form the rational input a/n

witness_dependencies: a depends on n and t via a = floor(n*t)
the point a/n depends on n and t through a

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, if a = floor(n*t), then E_n(t) <= E_n(a/n).
